name: loom-code
description: Five stations — write-plan, build, review, ship, maintain — carry one change from plan to merged PR, with a checker that recomputes the review before every push. Claude Code + Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Process-discipline + canon-grounded coding workflow for Codex CLI
interface.longDescription: Drives coding work through the full loom-code stage flow — brainstorming → plan-writing → subagent-driven development under the TDD iron law → systematic debugging → whole-branch code/docs review → verification → branch finishing — with parallel dispatch for independent domains. Every rule is grounded in primary sources (Beck, Fowler, Martin, OWASP, 徳丸本). Coexists with domain-teams:code-team and loom-workflow's git-memory; LOOM_CODE_MODE=off disables loom-code's hooks entirely — the SessionStart router card and the git push/commit guard both.
